title: Workout Plan
message: Start slow. Use light weight. Stop if you feel pain.

rest.name: Rest Day
rest.note: No gym today. Take a 20–30 min easy walk. Drink water. Sleep well. Muscles grow when you rest.

march.name: March in Place
march.about: Walk on the spot to warm up
steps: Stand straight. Relax your arms.
Lift one knee, then the other, like walking.
Swing your arms too.
Start slow, then go a little faster.

arm_circles.name: Arm Circles
steps: Lift both arms to the side, at shoulder height.
Make small circles. Slowly make them bigger.
Go forward first, then backward.
mistakes: Lifting shoulders up to the ears

hip_circles.name: Hip Circles
steps: Hands on your waist. Feet shoulder-width apart.
Slowly move your hips in a big circle.
Do the same number both ways.

bw_squat.name: Bodyweight Squat
bw_squat.about: Sit down and stand up, no weight
steps: Feet shoulder-width apart. Toes a little out.
Push your hips back, like sitting on a chair.
Keep your chest up and back straight.
Push through your heels to stand up.
bw_squat.tip: If it feels hard, put a chair behind you. Sit lightly on it, then stand.

chest_press_machine.name: Chest Press Machine
steps: Set the seat so the handles are at mid-chest.
Back flat on the pad. Feet on the floor.
Breathe out and push the handles forward. Don't lock your elbows.
Breathe in and slowly bring them back.
chest_press_machine.tip: Start with the lightest weight. The last 2 reps should feel a little hard. That's enough.

incline_db_press.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
incline_db_press.about: Push dumbbells up on a slanted bench
steps: Set the bench at a small angle (30°). Lie back.
Hold dumbbells near your chest. Elbows slightly down.
Breathe out and push the dumbbells up.
Slowly lower them. Feel a stretch in your chest.

db_shoulder_press.name: Seated Shoulder Press
steps: Set the bench upright. Sit with your back on it.
Hold dumbbells next to your ears. Palms forward.
Breathe out and push them up over your head.
Slowly bring them back to ear level.

lateral_raise.name: Lateral Raise
lateral_raise.about: Lift dumbbells out to the side
steps: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand.
Keep elbows a little bent.
Lift arms to the side, up to shoulder height. Not higher.
Slowly lower them.
lateral_raise.tip: This works best with very light weight.

face_pull.name: Face Pull
face_pull.about: Pull a rope toward your face
steps: Set the cable at eye level. Attach the rope.
Pull the rope toward your face. Hands go beside your ears.
Squeeze shoulders back. Hold for 1 second.
Slowly let it go back.
face_pull.tip: Great for fixing a bent posture.

triceps_pushdown.name: Triceps Pushdown
steps: Stand facing the cable machine. Hold the bar or rope.
Keep elbows close to your body.
Push down until your arms are straight. Only elbows move.
Slowly let it come back up.
mistakes: Leaning your body weight on it

db_curl.name: Dumbbell Curl
steps: Stand straight. Palms facing forward.
Keep elbows next to your body.
Lift the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Slowly lower them all the way down.

lat_pulldown.name: Lat Pulldown
lat_pulldown.about: Pull the bar down to your chest
steps: Fix the thigh pad tight. Sit down.
Hold the bar a little wider than your shoulders.
Chest up. Pull the bar down to your upper chest.
Slowly let it go up until arms are straight.

seated_row.name: Seated Cable Row
seated_row.about: Sit and pull the handle to your belly
steps: Feet on the platform. Knees a little bent.
Back straight. Chest up.
Pull the handle to your belly. Squeeze shoulders back.
Slowly let your arms go forward.

db_row.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
db_row.about: Pull a dumbbell up with one hand
steps: Put one knee and one hand on the bench. Back flat.
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm hanging down.
Pull your elbow back and up. Bring the dumbbell to your waist.
Slowly lower it. Then switch arms.

leg_press.name: Leg Press
leg_press.about: Push the platform with your feet
steps: Keep your back and hips flat on the seat.
Feet on the platform, shoulder-width apart.
Slowly bring knees toward your chest (about 90°).
Push through your heels. Don't lock your knees.
leg_press.tip: If your knees hurt, don't go down as far.

goblet_squat.name: Goblet Squat
goblet_squat.about: Squat holding a dumbbell at your chest
steps: Hold one dumbbell with both hands at your chest.
Feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit down like on a chair. Chest up.
Push through your heels to stand up.

leg_curl.name: Seated Leg Curl
leg_curl.about: Bend your legs down against the pad
steps: Sit on the machine. Pad sits just above your heels.
Lock the thigh pad tight.
Bend your legs down and back. Hold 1 second.
Slowly bring them back.

leg_extension.name: Leg Extension
leg_extension.about: Straighten your legs against the pad
steps: Sit on the machine. Pad sits on top of your ankles.
Hold the handles. Back on the seat.
Straighten your legs. Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly lower them.
leg_extension.tip: If your knees hurt, skip this or keep it very light.

calf_raise.name: Calf Raise
steps: Stand holding a wall or machine for balance.
Rise up on your toes as high as you can.
Hold 1 second at the top.
Slowly come down.

plank.name: Plank
plank.about: Hold your body straight like a board
steps: Elbows under shoulders. Lift your body on your toes.
Head to heels in one straight line.
Keep your belly tight. Keep breathing.
Too hard? Keep your knees on the floor.

chest_stretch.name: Doorway Chest Stretch
chest_stretch.about: Stretch your chest in a doorway
steps: Put your arms on the door frame at shoulder height.
Slowly step forward.
Feel a light stretch in your chest. Hold 30 seconds.

lat_stretch.name: Side Stretch
lat_stretch.about: Reach up and lean to the side
steps: Raise one arm up.
Slowly lean to the other side.
Feel the stretch in your side and back. Hold 30 seconds.

hamstring_stretch.name: Hamstring Stretch
hamstring_stretch.about: Sit and reach toward your foot
steps: Sit on the floor. One leg straight, one bent.
Keep your back straight and lean toward the straight leg.
Hold 30 seconds. Then switch legs.

quad_stretch.name: Standing Quad Stretch
steps: Stand holding a wall.
Bend one leg back and hold your ankle.
Keep knees together. Hold 30 seconds.
